command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: start test listener on 8080"
nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/http8080.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/http8080.pid
sleep 1
echo "STEP: verify listener up"
ss -tln | grep 8080

echo "STEP: curl 8080 from same node against NODE_IP (simulates external reachability through firewall path)"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "8080 http status: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/" || echo "8080 curl failed"

echo "STEP: attempt connection to an unrelated closed/blocked port e.g. 9090 (cockpit, now removed) - expect rejection/refused"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "9090 http status: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP:9090/" || echo "9090 connection failed as expected (rejected/refused)"

echo "STEP: nft rules confirm reject behavior present"
sudo -n nft list ruleset | grep -A2 'REJECT_public\|reject' | head -30 || true

echo "STEP: stop test listener"
kill "$(cat /tmp/http8080.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true
